description: For each department in the HR system, return all active employees who earn the second-highest DISTINCT salary of that department. Departments with fewer than two distinct salary values among active employees are omitted. Active means termination_date IS NULL. Output columns: department_name (STRING), employee_id (INT64), salary (NUMERIC). Sort by department_name, employee_id.

salary.description: Annual salary; NULL for unpaid interns

edge_cases: Two employees share the top salary; the second-highest distinct salary is still 90000
Department with a single distinct salary is omitted
NULL salaries must not be ranked as a salary level
Terminated employees are ignored when determining salary levels
common_failure_modes: FM4: RANK() or ROW_NUMBER() = 2 returns nothing or the wrong employee when the top salary is tied; DENSE_RANK() is required
FM5: NULL salary sorts last in DESC order in BigQuery but can still be assigned rank 2 in a department with one real salary level
